name: Low-Sodium Hospital Diet (2,000 mg)
description: Illustrative institutional low-sodium policy for cardiac / hypertension / heart-failure patients. Verify thresholds against your institution's current diet manual.

rules.title: Daily sodium must not exceed 2,000 mg
rules.source: WHO sodium guideline (<2,000 mg/day); AHA/DGA ceiling of 2,300 mg/day
rules.remedy: Swap processed or canned items for fresh or unsalted alternatives.

rules.title: Main meals should not exceed 800 mg sodium
rules.source: Institutional practice: distribute sodium across meals

rules.title: No processed/cured meats
rules.source: Low-sodium diet: avoid cured, smoked and deli meats
rules.remedy: Use fresh-roasted chicken, fish, or eggs instead.

rules.title: Avoid canned soups and other high-sodium convenience foods
rules.source: Low-sodium diet: limit canned and prepared foods

rules.title: At least 200 g vegetables per day
rules.source: DASH-style pattern: vegetables support potassium intake and BP control
rules.remedy: Add a vegetable side to lunch or dinner.
